title: Datasets for Large Language Models: A Comprehensive Survey

bias_targets.methodology: Surveying evaluation benchmarks (such as CrowS-Pairs and TRUSTGPT) that measure bias using contrasting sentence pairs for stereotypes and by measuring toxicity values across different demographic groups.
Reviewing datasets (e.g., CrowS-Pairs) that assess gender stereotypes through crowdsourced contrasting sentence pairs with varying degrees of stereotypical content.
Surveying benchmarks like CrowS-Pairs that evaluate prejudice regarding sexual orientation using contrasting stereotypical sentence pairs.
Reviewing evaluation datasets (such as CrowS-Pairs) that measure religious stereotypes and bias using contrasting sentence pairs.
Surveying datasets (e.g., CrowS-Pairs) that quantify age-based prejudice by evaluating model responses to contrasting sentence pairs.
Reviewing benchmark datasets that assess nationality-based stereotypes using crowdsourced contrasting sentence pairs.
Surveying evaluation benchmarks like CrowS-Pairs that measure bias against disabilities via varying degrees of stereotypical content in sentence pairs.
Reviewing datasets that evaluate stereotypes related to physical appearance using contrasting sentence pairs.
Surveying benchmark datasets that measure occupational prejudice through contrasting sentence pairs.
